Name: Random Start Day
Author: idermailer
Description:
Randomize start day, and fix aftermath.
The moving day can be to spring 1st ~ winter 28th, and actual game start from next day. If you moved a season's last day, season will change in next day.

[b][size=3]When do the year numbers go up?[/size][/b]
No matter when you start, the year goes up at the [u]end of winter[/u].

[b][size=3]Some events don't happen on time?[/size][/b]
Those events occur based on the number of days played. It was intended.

--------
Uses SMAPI, uses Harmony.
source code is [url=https://github.com/idermailer/RandomStartDay]here[/url]
